title: Arms Sales Notification
items_summary: Correction to an incorrect graphic of a letter (Transmittal No. 21-15) published in notice document 2025-22604 on page 57742 of the December 12, 2025 Federal Register.
summary: This is a correction notice to Defense Security Cooperation Agency notice 2025-22604, which appeared in the December 12, 2025 Federal Register. The corrected letter graphic itself is an image and its text is not included in the provided notice, so the purchasing country, items, values, and contractors cannot be determined from this text.
